body: A key ring and a bucket share a bitter residue. It looks like the field-sprayer test. They were bundled before the radio warned everyone indoors.
title: Key ring and bucket

body: The men building shelves were told to make another partition before the evacuation trucks came. Someone measured for beds and then scratched the measurements out. My brother still brought his tools, because the invoice for the first day had already been paid.
title: Notepad page
